correctness.rationale: Equilibrium elimination is exact. At each nonzero equilibrium the vector field is smooth, determinant expansion gives the stated cubic, and the nonzero Routh first-column entries have signs +,+,-,+ because pair existence forces 0<b<1; hence exactly two right-half-plane roots. The central differentiability failure follows from unequal one-sided derivatives of -|x_1|.
